Rules / Tool

SK9030 An analyzer threw

An analyzer raised an exception. The run finishes and every other rule's findings are kept, but the rules the analyzer carries reported nothing wherever it threw, so the verdict fails.

CategoryTool
Default severitywarning
ScopeCompilation
Needs a compilationno
Runs under --load=looseno
Cached per fileno — it reads the whole compilation
Fixno
Language version floor—
Since0.6

Why

A third-party analyzer that throws on one syntax shape must not be able to end the run early, green or red. It must not pass it either: a crashed rule produces exactly the zero a clean tree produces, so the gate fails on this at warning severity and the agent report opens with it rather than with OK. Roslyn does not disable an analyzer that threw — it keeps being invoked and keeps throwing — so the message counts how many times it did and names the rules whose zero means nothing.

When it does not fire

None; it reports an exception that happened.
